title: Ordinary duals of finite projective modules
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring and $P$ a finitely generated $A$-module [def-weil-finitely-generated-module] which is projective [def-weil-pbc-projective-module]. Its ordinary dual $P^*=\operatorname{Hom}_A(P,A)$ is finitely generated and projective, and the evaluation map $P\to P^{**}$, $x\mapsto(f\mapsto f(x))$, is an $A$-linear isomorphism.
